nodes.label: D-003 Validation rules in DB and form
nodes.norm_label: d-003 validation rules in db and form
nodes.rationale: BeeFood form accepted values the server silently corrected (B-006, R-011).

nodes.label: D-004 Server-side audit trigger
nodes.rationale: BeeFood 'before' state came from the browser (B-001).

nodes.label: D-005 Atomic composite operations
nodes.rationale: Avoid orphan groups when second call fails (B-005, R-015).

nodes.label: D-006 Write only on explicit action (atualizado_em versioning)
nodes.norm_label: d-006 write only on explicit action (atualizado_em versioning)
nodes.rationale: BeeFood tabs rewrote config on open (B-010, R-017).

nodes.label: D-007 Full UTF-8 text
nodes.rationale: BeeFood replaces emoji with '??' (B-002, R-006).

nodes.label: D-010 New product active in all brands/channels
nodes.norm_label: d-010 new product active in all brands/channels
nodes.rationale: Parity with BeeFood R-008 for restaurant familiarity.

nodes.label: D-013 Cash register sessions and blind closing
nodes.norm_label: d-013 cash register sessions and blind closing
nodes.rationale: Operators count cash without seeing expected totals; alert for registers open >16h (improvement over BeeFood EV-014/EV-021).

nodes.label: contas table plans and limits (plano, limite_lojas, limite_cardapios)
nodes.norm_label: contas table plans and limits (plano, limite_lojas, limite_cardapios)

nodes.label: D-002 Multi-store model: Loja → Marcas
nodes.rationale: Pilot restaurant runs 3 brands in one kitchen (dark kitchen); per-brand channel pricing via produto_marcas.

nodes.label: D-014 Printing queue in DB with snapshot coupons
nodes.norm_label: d-014 printing queue in db with snapshot coupons
nodes.rationale: Snapshot keeps reprints identical; ACBr-homologated model catalog; browser prints until agent exists.

nodes.label: D-015 RES Impressão Windows print agent
nodes.norm_label: d-015 res impressao windows print agent
nodes.rationale: Browser always shows print dialog; single .exe with pairing code → hashed token, no secret key on store PC; ESC/POS RAW over USB spooler or TCP 9100.

nodes.label: D-016 Printer shared across store group
nodes.norm_label: d-016 printer shared across store group
nodes.rationale: Stores of the same account share kitchen and printers.

nodes.label: D-043 Open API, webhooks and MCP server
nodes.norm_label: d-043 open api, webhooks and mcp server
nodes.rationale: Read-only scoped keys stored as hash; HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks via pg_net with pg_cron retries; MCP link-with-key is how ChatGPT/Claude accept without login.

nodes.label: Core/DB rule parity with shared test cases
nodes.norm_label: core/db rule parity with shared test cases
nodes.rationale: Each business rule implemented both in packages/core and Postgres (private.*) and verified with the same test cases.

nodes.label: D-021 Card-based menu and scheduled De/Por promotion
nodes.norm_label: d-021 card-based menu and scheduled de/por promotion
nodes.rationale: private.promo_vigente (DB) and promoVale (core) share test cases.

nodes.label: D-022 Combos with choices and up-sell category
nodes.norm_label: d-022 combos with choices and up-sell category
nodes.rationale: Combos excluded from cross-store import because choices point to that store's products.

nodes.label: D-023 Category %, coupons and counter discount with limit
nodes.norm_label: d-023 category %, coupons and counter discount with limit
nodes.rationale: Discount above store limit requires one-time manager authorization valid 10 min.

nodes.label: D-025 Customer registry per group by phone
nodes.norm_label: d-025 customer registry per group by phone
nodes.rationale: Digital menu does not look up by phone to avoid exposing others' addresses.

nodes.label: D-029 Customer RFM-style segments
nodes.rationale: Explainable fixed thresholds; computed on the fly; 'Em risco' added as most valuable to reactivate.

nodes.label: D-030 Phone normalization with mobile 9th digit
nodes.norm_label: d-030 phone normalization with mobile 9th digit
nodes.rationale: Format accepted by SMS and ad platforms; migration 0031 merges duplicates.

nodes.label: D-031 Loyalty program: cashback and points (group)
nodes.norm_label: d-031 loyalty program: cashback and points (group)
nodes.rationale: Earned on completion (not overnight like BeeFood); expiry counted from last order; device proof via secret order code prevents spending another's balance.

nodes.label: D-032 Loyalty separated per store (supersedes D-031 group rule)
nodes.norm_label: d-032 loyalty separated per store (supersedes d-031 group rule)
nodes.rationale: Owner request: everything per store; customer registry remains group-wide.

nodes.label: D-033 Simpler loyalty configuration
nodes.rationale: Single cashback % every day; weak days handled by coupons with weekdays.

nodes.label: D-020 Delivery km, motoboy fee per neighborhood, night closing
nodes.norm_label: d-020 delivery km, motoboy fee per neighborhood, night closing
nodes.rationale: Free OSRM/Nominatim with rate limits, 1 lookup/s; shift 05:00→05:00.

nodes.label: D-026 Real-time motoboy tracking
nodes.rationale: Only tracks while delivery is en route; native background-geolocation because Android throttles WebView requests in background.

nodes.label: D-027 Suggested route for multiple deliveries (otimizarRota)
nodes.norm_label: d-027 suggested route for multiple deliveries (otimizarrota)
nodes.rationale: Cost = driving minutes + 3 × lateness minutes; brute force up to 8 stops, greedy beyond.

nodes.label: D-028 Customer tracking, store deadline, batching and delay reports
nodes.norm_label: d-028 customer tracking, store deadline, batching and delay reports
nodes.rationale: Customer map only shows motoboy when their order is next stop, to not expose other deliveries.

nodes.label: D-019 RES Motoboy Android app and cross-browser QR reader (jsQR)
nodes.norm_label: d-019 res motoboy android app and cross-browser qr reader (jsqr)
nodes.rationale: BarcodeDetector failed on iPhone/Samsung Internet; app only loads the site so no new APK for improvements; no App Store yet (needs Apple developer account).

nodes.label: D-009 Group pricing (soma, brinde, maior, proporcional)
nodes.norm_label: d-009 group pricing (soma, brinde, maior, proporcional)
nodes.rationale: Provisional (Q-009); isolated in packages/core/src/preco.ts to verify against BeeFood.

nodes.label: D-036 Stock: NF-e entry and recipe-based deduction
nodes.norm_label: d-036 stock: nf-e entry and recipe-based deduction
nodes.rationale: Stock per store or group (contas.estoque_compartilhado); weighted average cost; sales never blocked; SEFAZ auto-fetch deferred (needs A1 cert).

nodes.label: D-038 Meu estoque and stock count
nodes.norm_label: d-038 meu estoque and stock count

nodes.label: D-039 Monthly closing and CMV (COGS)
nodes.rationale: Real CMV = opening + purchases − closing at average cost, compared with recipe-based theoretical CMV.

nodes.label: D-040 Recipe per pizza flavor with size factor
nodes.norm_label: d-040 recipe per pizza flavor with size factor
nodes.rationale: Write flavor recipe once; updated 28/10 to size by number of flavors (owner request), diameter area kept as option.

nodes.label: D-041 Pizza recipe screen appears automatically
nodes.norm_label: d-041 pizza recipe screen appears automatically
nodes.rationale: Menu decides; feature gating by plan, not by segment.

nodes.label: D-018 Kitchen ticket with motoboy QR and 'already paid'
nodes.community_name: D-017 Motoboy app with dispatch by order QR
nodes.norm_label: d-018 kitchen ticket with motoboy qr and 'already paid'
nodes.rationale: Many stores print only the kitchen copy, so QR and COBRAR/PAGO go there too.

nodes.community_name: D-017 Motoboy app with dispatch by order QR
nodes.rationale: Order was by random id; pedido_item_opcoes.ordem keeps chosen order. Agent bumped to 1.3.0.

nodes.norm_label: d-044 mercado pago pix with automatic confirmation
nodes.rationale: Pasted Access Token instead of OAuth (no approved RES app needed); server re-fetches payment since notification body is untrusted; orders await payment before kitchen (0043/0044).
